title: The Lucky Cigar Case
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro, Ran, Conan, Inspector Yokomizo) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file (s1=Umetani as murderer_id) got the culprit right, but several other details wrong or missing against the full transcript: (1) the stated motive 'victim blackmailed him over a stolen chair design, threatening exposure' is not in the transcript at all -- Hiramatsu's real leverage was the self-destructing Aimuzu chair he'd programmed (o4), used to force Umetani to release him from his employment contract, not any theft/exposure threat; (2) the old file's event order has Umetani's car sabotage happening before the stabbing 'e3', but the sabotage (brake line + mirror + tire puncturing) was set up earlier that day, independent of and prior to the staged private stabbing, which Umetani provoked using a hidden cigar case (o7) worn over the Kuron logo's 'O' as concealed armor; the old file also says Hiramatsu stabbed Umetani 'twice', but the transcript shows a single stab; (3) the old file omits entirely Hiramatsu's own backstory counter-plot -- police found a rope, stun gun, and a forged will in Umetani's name (o5, o6) hidden in Hiramatsu's room, meaning Hiramatsu had prepared a backup plan to kill Umetani and stage it as Umetani's own suicide if the blackmail failed; Umetani discovered this kit that morning and used the knowledge to turn the plot around on Hiramatsu instead; (4) the old file's clues (c1/c2 in the old file, covering tire punctures/delayed event and the mirror) are kept here as c3/c4, but the two clues that actually break Umetani's alibi in the transcript -- the cigar case's cigar capacity contradicting his stated 40-cigars-a-day habit (c1), and Hiramatsu's incongruous smile on the security video despite Umetani's claimed refusal (c2) -- are missing from the old file entirely. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Umetani smokes ~40 cigars a day, but the cigar case that stopped the knife holds only 4-5 cigars -- proves it wasn't his usual case and was deliberately planted as armor.
Security video shows Hiramatsu smiling right after Umetani claims he refused Hiramatsu's request -- contradicts Umetani's account of the meeting.
The corner mirror was confirmed properly angled that afternoon, but found repositioned that night -- narrows the window to whoever was alone at the facility in between.

Only Hiramatsu's car had its brakes cut; every other car had its tires punctured instead -- shows the same person selectively sabotaged the whole fleet to guarantee Hiramatsu specifically would crash and couldn't be followed.
